title: Uncle Mike's fridge
notes: The house list. The app loads it by itself the first time a device opens it: drinks that are missing are added with these counts, drinks already in the fridge are left alone. Change the id to push a new list. Each line is [catalog id, count].

fixes.why: The owner counted three on hand (2026-11-26). Applied once per device.
The owner's is a can, not a bottle (2026-11-27). The 2025 edition came only in bottles, so this is the 2024 can.
